attributes.board_name: Missouri State Committee for Social Workers

rules.accepted_credit_types: Committee-approved courses/providers (approved course list on MOPRO) and other social work CE per 20 CSR 2263-2.082; self-study allowed and listed separately on the summary sheet
rules.new_licensee_rule: Hours are prorated for the first renewal.
rules.audit_note: Summary sheet of CE signed as an attestation; documentation required if audited. Inactive renewal needs no CE.

topics.who: Ethics presented by a social worker from an accredited school or a professional knowledgeable in social work ethics
Suicide assessment, referral, treatment and management training
Effective Jan 1, 2027 - Dec 31, 2031: 2 h at the first renewal after initial licensure, then 1 h each renewal

rules.notes: Licenses expire September 30 (check expiration date on license); 24-month term per RSMo 337.618. Carryover of hours is referenced on the summary sheet but not detailed on board pages.
